scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @smit/api" "npm run dev -w @smit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smit/shared && npm run build -w @smit/api && npm run build -w @smit/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @smit/shared && npm run build -w @smit/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @smit/api && npm run lint -w @smit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @smit/api && npm run typecheck -w @smit/web
